featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually don’t leave reviews, but I feel compelled to share my disappointing experience. First off, the customer service was incredibly lacking. The staff seemed uninterested and unhelpful, which made the entire experience feel very uncomfortable. I waited much longer than expected for my order, and when it finally arrived, it was cold and not at all what I had asked for.

The ambiance was nothing to write home about either. The place was poorly lit, and the decor felt outdated and drab. To make matters worse, the bathroom was dirty, and the overall cleanliness of the restaurant was far below acceptable standards.

I also found the pricing to be absurd for the quality of food and service I received. It’s clear that this place is not focused on its customers, and I won’t be returning. Definitely not worth the hype.

featured_reviews.name: chaitanya sutar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a horrendous experience with Pink Homes, especially with brokers Rahul and Pramod. From the start, they run a disgusting bait-and-switch: showing you a series of awful properties, then presenting one decent one to trap you. After signing, it escalates horribly. They hound you for references, and even after paying rent on time, they harass you with false accusations—claiming you host guests, drink, smoke, or damage the place. Each repair request is twisted, and after a few months, Rahul and Pramod even escalate to physical visits, intimidating you in person. If you don’t give them further business, they will harass you relentlessly, push you to give notice, and invent excuses to force you out so they can profit from a new client. Once you give notice, they treat you disgustingly—speaking rudely, forging bills, and trying to rob you of your rightful deposit. Avoid Pink Homes and these brokers at all costs—this is a vicious, exploitative cycle that will leave you robbed and disrespected. They exploit college students the most, so BEWARE!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stayed at Om Sai Paying Guest for a few months and honestly, it turned out better than I expected. It’s not some fancy place, but it gets the basics right — clean rooms, decent space, and a setup that actually feels livable day-to-day.

The best part is the people managing it. They’re pretty chill and helpful, not the kind who bother you unnecessarily but still there if you need something fixed. That balance is rare.

Location also works in your favor — everything you need is close by, so you don’t end up struggling with daily stuff.

Overall, if you want a no-drama, reliable PG that feels safe and practical, this is a solid choice. Definitely worth it for the price.
